title: Financial Assistance Program (Charity Care) — Collection Protection Settings
content:
## Extraordinary collection action settings

| Tier | Every ECA on eligible encounters suspended from receipt of an application until determination | ECA reversal requested within (days after approval) | Refund review within (days after approval) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Riverbend Presumptive Charity Care | yes | 30 | 30 |
| Riverbend Full Charity Care (0-200% FPL) | yes | 30 | 30 |
| Riverbend 80% Charity Discount (201-250% FPL) | yes | 30 | 30 |
| Riverbend 60% Charity Discount (251-300% FPL) | yes | 30 | 30 |
| Riverbend 40% Charity Discount (301-400% FPL) | yes | 30 | 30 |
| Riverbend Medical Hardship Assistance (above 400% FPL) | yes | 30 | 30 |

Under the Financial Assistance Program (Charity Care), the reversal figure is the integer calendar days after approval within which Riverbend requests reversal of every ECA taken on covered encounters (agency recall, credit-report deletion); the refund figure is the integer calendar days after approval within which payments above the FAP liability on covered encounters are sent for refund.
